title: Pre-Decision Gold-Yen Joint Risk State and Portfolio Economics

macro_program.name: external_market_event
macro_program.reason: The treatment is a causal external gold-and-yen price state completed before every native decision, not an execution or broker-safety intervention.

research_height.transfer_path: early-day external gold/yen state -> native signal and birth supply -> component lifecycle stressed-R and stop channel -> both-book portfolio risk/lot decision

central_question: When gold rises while the yen strengthens before the current portfolio begins evaluating entries, does that joint risk-off state change native opportunity supply and produce materially broader favorable or adverse stressed lifecycle economics than the opposite joint risk-on state?

lenses: mechanism: classify a threshold-free joint external state only when XAUUSD and USDJPY move in the economically opposed risk-off or risk-on directions
transmission: compare normal-day native signal count, durable-birth count and signal-deficit incidence between the two states without imputing absent opportunities
portfolio result and falsification: compare component-period-centered stressed-R and stop burden with both-book, period, component and contribution breadth
research_bundle.common_boundary: Only physical XAUUSD and USDJPY H1 bars completed by server 12:00 and the same immutable fixed-0.01 CP2 event/lifecycle population are used. No later same-day external bar or outcome-fitted state is allowed.

rejected_before_opening.reason: Unit 075 requires naturally complete independently authorized future evidence and explicitly forbids manufacturing or reacquiring the missing 2,235-lifecycle binding ledger as a logger rescue. Source topology also forbids executing frozen RLO1 source from another family.

The currently accessible FRED ICE BofA daily series is truncated to three years from April 2026 and does not cover the complete four-period CP2 horizon; its historical publication timestamp is also not encoded in the observation rows.

Historical report dates do not encode release dates, the 2025 publication interruption breaks a simple causal weekly join, and legacy lineage already contains a Cross-specific CFTC positioning management closure. It is not the smallest clean new role.

frontier_selection.selection_reason: It adds two genuinely external tradable-market price roles with no publication-vintage ambiguity, precedes all native decisions, spans the full horizon, connects directly to both-book risk and opportunity supply, and is materially different from the latest scheduled-release M5 shock.

why_now.current_bottleneck: Units 050 and 072 preserve asymmetric US30/US100 economic roles, while Unit 085 found a large upstream signal-supply shortfall. Existing internal participation, dispersion, rate, calendar and scheduled-event states did not identify a treatment. A causal cross-asset risk state is still absent.
connection_bridge: Unit 050 found US30 broadly offsets US100 drawdown while the reverse direction fails, and Unit 072 preserved US100 as a positive but lower-yield sleeve receiving US30 protection.

Unit 085 found 92.35 percent of the three-start shortfall remains upstream even under perfect conversion, so an external state that changes signal supply or filled value would affect portfolio risk and research priority rather than only one entry row.
XAUUSD-up plus USDJPY-down is observable before the first 12:15 decision and can be joined to every normal day without Live or broker-account state.
why_now.perspective_distance_from_recent: Unit 087 used a fifteen-minute three-US-index reaction to scheduled CPI and Employment releases and stopped before outcomes. Unit 088 uses no event calendar or US-index state: it moves to a threshold-free, early-day gold/yen cross-asset regime and follows it through daily signal supply and complete four-period portfolio lifecycles.
why_now.decision_if_risk_off_is_favorable: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future whole-portfolio real-tick question asking whether risk or lot may be increased only in the fixed favorable state.
why_now.decision_if_risk_off_is_adverse: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future whole-portfolio real-tick question asking whether risk or lot should be reduced only in the fixed adverse state.
why_now.decision_if_no_field_ambiguous_or_invali: Preserve unconditional behavior, retain no gold/yen seed and rotate away.

whole_map_recomparison.program_1: No unconsumed causal signal seed remains after Units 085-086; this unit does not invent another entry transform.
whole_map_recomparison.program_2: Selected only because XAUUSD and USDJPY create a new external price mechanism and data role beyond closed US-index participation, dispersion, rates, VIX, calendar and event paths.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: Priority, occupancy, pending reservation, handoff and latency roles remain closed or density-limited; no clock permutation is reopened.
whole_map_recomparison.program_4: Profit-memory and peer-exit evidence still lacks a newly causal remaining-path trigger; no management threshold is opened.
whole_map_recomparison.program_5: The implementation consequence is portfolio risk/lot, but the unanswered cause begins outside the portfolio and must first pass both-book lifecycle evidence.
whole_map_recomparison.program_7: The RLO1 unused-field and metadata audits have no new decision-changing role; no repeated synthesis is opened.
whole_map_recomparison.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 and all heights. Do not automatically open another metal, FX, clock, return window, threshold, subgroup, risk or lot variant.

acquisition_contract.copy_rule: One physical minimal copy from the neutral Lab runtime; no source, executable, settings, state, log or runtime dependency on another family or Live.
acquisition_contract.request: For XAUUSD and USDJPY call copy_rates_range once each at H1 from 2022-07-01 00:00:00 through 2026-08-21 23:59:59 UTC request coordinates and preserve terminal-formatted server time.
acquisition_contract.forbidden_api_calls: Every account, position, order, deal, check, send or trading-state API.
acquisition_contract.freeze_before_outcomes: Export both symbols, symbol specs and one acquisition receipt; commit and push them before reconstructing any lifecycle or calculating any state-conditioned outcome.

frozen_market_state.time_semantics: Use time_server exactly as emitted by the dedicated terminal; do not timezone-remap.
frozen_market_state.start_price: For each symbol and server date, use the open of the first physical H1 bar whose server opening time is 00:00, 01:00 or 02:00. Require exactly one earliest qualifying bar and do not synthesize a missing bar.
frozen_market_state.end_price: Use the close of the H1 bar opening exactly 11:00 and completing at 12:00.
frozen_market_state.symbol_return: Natural log of end_price divided by start_price; require finite positive prices.
frozen_market_state.risk_off: XAUUSD return strictly positive and USDJPY return strictly negative.
frozen_market_state.risk_on: XAUUSD return strictly negative and USDJPY return strictly positive.
frozen_market_state.mixed: Every other finite sign combination, including an exact zero return; context only and not part of the primary contrast.
frozen_market_state.causal_boundary: The end bar is complete at 12:00 before the earliest native decision at 12:15.
frozen_market_state.daily_assignment: Assign each SIZE_DAY date and every signal/birth/lifecycle by its server-calendar date.

frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.ordering: Within each period concatenate pinned files and preserve stable source-file/source-row order for equal server timestamps.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.normal_day: Each unique SIZE_DAY server date is one normal portfolio day.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.native_signal: Each SIGNAL_DECIDED row is one observed native passed opportunity. Do not infer signals behind absent rows.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.birth: OPEN for RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure and Return; PASSIVE_FILL for Passive.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.final: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE paired by strict per-component alternation. Stressed P/L is value_b; planned_risk and DEAL_REASON are parsed from detail.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.stressed_r: value_b divided by positive planned_risk at final close.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.stop: One when close detail reason is DEAL_REASON_SL, otherwise zero for DEAL_REASON_EXPERT.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.centered_outcomes: For each lifecycle subtract its component-period all-eligible-state mean stressed_r and stop rate. RISK_OFF minus RISK_ON centered differences are primary.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.supply_metrics: Report mean SIGNAL_DECIDED count, mean durable-birth count and fewer-than-three-signal day share in RISK_OFF, RISK_ON and MIXED within each period and pooled. These metrics are transmission context and cannot by themselves select a treatment.

requirements: All declared byte/hash pins pass; both acquired exports are unique, strictly increasing and contain valid finite positive OHLC with nonnegative volume/spread fields.

Lifecycle reconstruction yields exactly 2,233 complete pairs, including 2,027 CLOSE and 206 EXTERNAL_CLOSE finals, with component, period, book, stressed-net and 206-stop anchors matching prior authority within 1e-9.
Exactly 1,051 SIZE_DAY dates and 2,429 SIGNAL_DECIDED rows reconstruct with zero duplicate or unmatched event.
At least 95 percent of normal days and lifecycles in every period map to a finite external state.
RISK_OFF and RISK_ON each represent at least 12 percent of mapped normal dates in every period.
Each pooled component-primary-state cell contains at least 15 lifecycles and each period-book-primary-state cell contains at least 20.

favorable_risk_off: Pooled centered RISK_OFF-minus-RISK_ON stressed_r is at least +0.10R.
Pooled centered RISK_OFF-minus-RISK_ON stop rate is at most -0.05.
The concordant favorable direction appears in both books, at least three of four periods and at least four of six components.
No one period contributes more than 60 percent and no one component more than 45 percent of the absolute pooled stressed-R contrast.
adverse_risk_off: Pooled centered RISK_OFF-minus-RISK_ON stressed_r is at most -0.10R.
Pooled centered RISK_OFF-minus-RISK_ON stop rate is at least +0.05.
The concordant adverse direction appears in both books, at least three of four periods and at least four of six components.
No one period contributes more than 60 percent and no one component more than 45 percent of the absolute pooled stressed-R contrast.

requirements: Absolute pooled centered RISK_OFF-minus-RISK_ON stressed_r is less than 0.05R.
Absolute pooled centered RISK_OFF-minus-RISK_ON stop rate is less than 0.025.
Neither concordant direction appears in more than two periods or more than three components.

fixed_verdict_rules.favorable: PASS_PREDECISION_GOLD_YEN_RISK_OFF_FAVORABLE_PORTFOLIO_STATE when integrity and every favorable gate pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.adverse: PASS_PREDECISION_GOLD_YEN_RISK_OFF_ADVERSE_PORTFOLIO_STATE when integrity and every adverse gate pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.no_field: NO_MATERIAL_PREDECISION_GOLD_YEN_RISK_STATE when integrity passes and the complete strong-null rule triggers.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_PREDECISION_GOLD_YEN_RISK_STATE_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity passes and no preceding economic verdict applies.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_PREDECISION_GOLD_YEN_RISK_STATE_NO_VERDICT when any pin, acquisition, bar, event, lifecycle, coverage or density integrity requirement fails.

decision_translation.favorable_or_adverse: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future whole-portfolio real-tick risk-or-lot treatment question in the observed direction. This sign state is exploratory and does not itself authorize an implementation.
decision_translation.no_field_or_ambiguous: Preserve unconditional behavior, retain no seed and rotate away.
decision_translation.invalid: Preserve the observation gap and rotate away without same-family repair after budget exhaustion.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration and the single Frontier memory before creating the runtime or acquiring XAUUSD/USDJPY data.
Commit and push both acquired bar exports, symbol specs and the receipt before reconstructing lifecycles or calculating any state-conditioned outcome.
One acquisition/serialization correction is allowed only before any conditional lifecycle or supply metric is emitted. After any new metric, make no correction or rerun.
Do not change symbols, clocks, sign states, outcomes, thresholds, breadth, concentration, verdicts or decisions after results.
Do not create MQL, compile, run Tester, query broker/account/position/order/deal state, touch Live or open Program 6.
